name: One paramedic, one shift, two calls (the stage demo)
note: Call 1 is the stroke story (voice only, dispatch context, county routing, the allergy contradiction). Call 2 shows the same copilot on a different call: a fall that is also a heart attack, with a photo of a wearable and of a pill bottle, medications and procedures recorded as given, the STEMI and trauma checklists open together, a protocol question, and the written handoff.
